native_contract: Six opaque 64x64 tiles, reduced once from 466-px swatches.
prepared_sheet: The six picked swatches pasted unscaled on one sheet (a 3 x 2 grid, magenta between), with the measured crops, by crates/delve/assets/griffinwing/prepare-art.py. Every pixel is a delivered pixel. source_path and source_sha256 are the prepared sheet; picked_sha256 binds each swatch.
rich_sheets: external, bound by absolute path and SHA-256; only native PNGs, the map, this record and the review sheet are in the repository
selected_sheet: v01/picked/{rock,stone,causeway,bone,lava,mist}.png, the producer's six chosen swatches (bone from the re-run in v01/source-sheet.png; rock, lava and mist from the first run's second image in v01-first; rock wrap-blended in y and mist in x by the lane). The importer reads the six pasted unscaled on one sheet
